name: check-code
description: 🩻🔬 After each edit, checks just the lines Claude changed for bugs, style slips and risky patterns, using the code-checking tools you already have (ruff, shellcheck, biome and more), and hands any problems straight back so they get fixed in the same turn. Your repo's own settings are respected, an edit is never blocked, and a clean edit costs nothing. Five built-in checks need no tools at all.
